{{Top|sprot}}

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{FileRenameRequest|</nowiki>{{Var|reason}}|{{Var|NewFileName.extension}}}}</code>

Do not include "File:" before the new suggested file name as this will cause the template to not display correctly. For example, put '''NewFileName.png''' and not '''File:NewFileName.png'''.

Once the template is placed on a file page, an automated report is sent in the <code>#automated-reports</code> channel of the [[Wookieepedia:Discord|Wookieepedia Discord]] for administrators and rollbacks to handle when convenient.
